limits: Confidence truncates Gaussian tails and is conservative; outside estimated rectangle does not prove all RGB correct
Source pixels/masks/registration/epoch and accepted baseline remain unchanged
Reflection layers are an existing empirical unrefracted source-environment proxy, not Apple reflection rays
Geometry/filter directions use saved rejected SAME-baseline native material arrays, no reruns or new fits
Neutral basis projections are center-sampled diagnostic proxies, not fitted colors or exact native derivatives
Crops and cohort splits are advisory; they never replace full native gates or exclude bad score pixels
Projection signs/correlations cannot uniquely identify optics; compare cohort sample sizes and mixed support
